name: Abdrahman Abubakar
headline: I build fast, reliable web applications, from the interface to the database.
intro: Frontend & full-stack developer working with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL. I recently completed a 30-day challenge, shipping one project every day.
availability: Available now for full-time roles and freelance or contract work. Open to remote work worldwide and to relocating.
about:
I'm a full-stack developer and engineer who builds web applications end to end. On the frontend, I work with HTML5, CSS, Javascript, React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS to create interfaces that are fast, accessible and easy to use. On the backend, I build APIs, design PostgreSQL and MySQL databases, write PHP back ends and set up authentication, so the whole product holds together.

I learn by shipping. I recently completed a 30-day challenge, building and shipping one project a day, from React fundamentals to full-stack apps with AI features.

I'm available now for full-time roles and freelance or contract work. I work remotely with teams worldwide, I'm open to relocating, and I can start immediately, ready to contribute from day one, take on unfamiliar problems and keep growing as an engineer.

highlights.title: Tenant isolation, enforced twice
highlights.text: Every query is scoped to the signed-in workspace in the service layer, and composite foreign keys in PostgreSQL stop data crossing between businesses even if the code has a bug.

highlights.title: Money correct to the kobo
highlights.text: Amounts are stored as integer kobo, invoices get gapless numbers, and stock can't go below zero even when two people sell the last item at the same moment.

highlights.title: An AI assistant you can trust
highlights.text: It answers in English or Pidgin using a fixed set of read-only tools, never writes SQL, and every figure is checked against the tool results. Anything it drafts needs a person's approval.

highlights.title: Built from first principles
highlights.text: Auth, sessions, rate limiting, migrations and accessible SVG charts with no ORM or UI library, plus a script that checks the ledger's rules against a real database.

experience.description: Designed, built and shipped 30 web applications in 30 days, from React fundamentals to Ledgerline, a multi-tenant AI business platform. Each one is live, with public code and a write-up.
